name: Singapore

meta.title: Study in Singapore from India: Tuition Grant, bond, job search pass
meta.description: How Singapore's MOE Tuition Grant and 3-year bond work, the 1-year Long Term Visit Pass to look for a job after study, and how Wayfarer helps.

summary: A government Tuition Grant that lowers fees in return for 3 years of work in Singapore, and a year to find a job after graduating.

whyReasons.text: International students at eligible universities can apply for the MOE Tuition Grant, which lowers fees. In return you must work full-time for a Singapore entity for 3 years after graduating.
Tuition Grant holders can apply for a 1-year Long Term Visit Pass when their Student's Pass expires, to stay and look for work.

afterStudy.text: Tuition Grant holders can apply for a 1-year Long Term Visit Pass after their Student's Pass expires, to look for work. The pass is cancelled once a work pass is issued.

scholarships.name: MOE Tuition Grant
scholarships.text: Lowers tuition at eligible institutions. You must work for a Singapore entity for 3 years after graduating.

faq.q: What is the Tuition Grant bond?
faq.a: If you take the MOE Tuition Grant, you must work full-time for a Singapore entity for 3 years after you graduate. Time can be spread across different employers.

faq.q: Can I stay to look for a job after studying?
faq.a: Tuition Grant holders can apply for a 1-year Long Term Visit Pass when their Student's Pass expires. Your employer then applies for your work pass.
